name: Puddle Frog
notes: DRAFT for C13-2 (bestiary-plan.md). Hops in an arc and lands with a splash. Stats set in R-BAL-8 (#185/#186). Distances in tiles, times in ticks (20 per second).
tell: red circle where it will land
senseiLine: Watch where it lands. Then move.
description: Hops in an arc and lands with a splash.

bestiary.tip: Step out, then calm it while it blinks.

lore.blue: A happy pond frog that got lost in the mist. Calm it, and it hops home to its lily pad.
